capabilities: Dim non-active editor lines in Focus Mode
Center or upper-third cursor line in Typewriter Mode
Toggle both modes together with Zen Mode
extras: Only affects Markdown editor views (Live Preview and Source Mode); Reading Mode is unchanged. Visual results depend on the active theme. The plugin handles F8/F9 itself, so binding its commands in Obsidian Hotkeys would double-toggle.
intentEvidence: Centerline is an Obsidian plugin that provides Typora-style focus and typewriter modes
problem: Obsidian's Markdown editor does not dim surrounding lines or keep the cursor line vertically centered while writing.

relations.evidence: provides Typora-style focus and typewriter modes for Markdown editors

summary: Typora-style focus and typewriter modes for Obsidian Markdown editors, with dimmed non-active lines and centered cursor scrolling.
